name: Committee Explorer compatibility export semantic datasets

description.purpose: Describe compatibility browser tables and their complete publication manifest.
description.limitations: Parquet is the only supported new export format; JSON export is retired. Exact output fields, Arrow types and nullability remain owned by committee_explorer.parquet.TABLE_SCHEMAS/SOURCE_SCHEMA. These minimal semantic definitions do not reproduce those schemas. Incoming assembled Catalog graph validation remains committee_meeting-owned; output partitions are not individually a complete Catalog.
